scope: Hand-derived future scanner controls only; no scanner implementation/runtime proof.

vectors.name: before-marker-NaN
vectors.derivation: At byte 5, N cannot begin a JSON value; no marker has completed.
vectors.status: normative expected facts; not executed by this proposal

vectors.name: before-marker-Infinity
vectors.derivation: At byte 5, I cannot begin a JSON value; no marker has completed.
vectors.status: normative expected facts; not executed by this proposal

vectors.name: before-marker--Infinity
vectors.derivation: The minus at byte 5 can begin a number, but I at byte 6 cannot continue it.
vectors.status: normative expected facts; not executed by this proposal

vectors.name: before-marker-01
vectors.derivation: Zero at byte 5 forms the permitted leading-zero number; the second digit at byte 6 is not a permitted continuation.
vectors.status: normative expected facts; not executed by this proposal

vectors.name: after-marker-minus-infinity
vectors.derivation: Completed marker survives later lexical error.
vectors.status: normative expected facts; not executed by this proposal

vectors.name: after-root-invalid-raw-byte
vectors.derivation: Decode the next scalar before trailing-root lexical classification.
vectors.status: normative expected facts; not executed by this proposal

vectors.name: after-root-nonascii-scalar
vectors.derivation: Decode the next scalar before trailing-root lexical classification.
vectors.status: normative expected facts; not executed by this proposal

vectors.name: after-root-ascii-junk
vectors.derivation: Decode the next scalar before trailing-root lexical classification.
vectors.status: normative expected facts; not executed by this proposal

vectors.name: complete-with-trailing-whitespace
vectors.derivation: Complete JSON plus allowed whitespace, absolute offset includes whitespace.
vectors.status: normative expected facts; not executed by this proposal

vectors.name: completed-marker-before-eof
vectors.derivation: Completed value token is enough even though root is incomplete.
vectors.status: normative expected facts; not executed by this proposal

vectors.name: unfinished-marker-string
vectors.derivation: No completed STRING value token.
vectors.status: normative expected facts; not executed by this proposal

vectors.name: six-raw-byte-unpaired-root-name
vectors.derivation: Code-unit name unequal to schema, no scalar-decoding stop.
vectors.status: normative expected facts; not executed by this proposal

vectors.name: twenty-five-raw-byte-unpaired-marker-value
vectors.derivation: Equal raw length is deliberate; decoded value is not the ASCII marker.
vectors.status: normative expected facts; not executed by this proposal

vectors.name: before-marker-raw-ff
vectors.derivation: The FF byte at 2 can begin no well-formed UTF-8 sequence; its first maximal subpart starts at 2, before any marker.
vectors.status: normative expected facts; not executed by this proposal

vectors.name: before-marker-encoded-surrogate
vectors.derivation: The first maximal subpart of ED A0 80 starts at ED at byte 2; encoded surrogate scalars are ill-formed UTF-8, so no later marker is discovered.
vectors.status: normative expected facts; not executed by this proposal

vectors.name: before-marker-overlong
vectors.derivation: C0 at byte 2 can begin no well-formed UTF-8 sequence; the first maximal subpart starts there, before any marker.
vectors.status: normative expected facts; not executed by this proposal

vectors.name: before-marker-above-max
vectors.derivation: F4 followed by 90 would encode above U+10FFFF; the first maximal subpart begins at byte 2, before any marker.
vectors.status: normative expected facts; not executed by this proposal

vectors.name: truncated-multibyte-at-eof
vectors.derivation: The scalar starting with E2 at byte 6 lacks its last continuation byte at EOF; report utf8 at first maximal-subpart start 6, not eof at input length 8.
vectors.status: normative expected facts; not executed by this proposal

vectors.name: raw-utf8-fault-before-invalid-escape
vectors.derivation: No token-wide lazy decoder may prefer the later invalid escape.
vectors.status: normative expected facts; not executed by this proposal

vectors.name: earlier-json-stop-before-later-utf8
vectors.derivation: No whole-file UTF8 prevalidation or recovery into the later marker.
vectors.status: normative expected facts; not executed by this proposal

vectors.name: leading-complete-bom
vectors.derivation: The complete initial BOM is the explicit profile exception.
vectors.status: normative expected facts; not executed by this proposal

vectors.name: root-plus-63-arrays-depth64
vectors.derivation: Root container depth1 plus63 arrays is allowed.
vectors.status: normative expected facts; not executed by this proposal

vectors.name: root-plus-64-arrays-depth65
vectors.derivation: Opening array64 is container65 at absolute byte5+63.
vectors.status: normative expected facts; not executed by this proposal

vectors.name: marker-before-depth65
vectors.derivation: Earlier completed root marker survives the depth stop.
vectors.status: normative expected facts; not executed by this proposal

vectors.name: nonobject-root-with-nested-lookalike
vectors.derivation: Nonobject root yields no candidate but scanning facts still cover the full document.
vectors.status: normative expected facts; not executed by this proposal

vectors.name: empty-input
vectors.derivation: No complete root at EOF.
vectors.status: normative expected facts; not executed by this proposal

vectors.name: whitespace-only
vectors.derivation: No root value begins before input length 2; otherwise well-formed UTF-8 is exhausted.
vectors.status: normative expected facts; hand-derived, not executed by this proposal

vectors.name: multibyte-cut-short-by-string-quote
vectors.derivation: The scalar beginning with E2 at byte 6 has one continuation byte, then a quote rather than the required continuation. First maximal-subpart start is 6, not the rejection-detection position 8.
vectors.status: normative expected facts; hand-derived, not executed by this proposal

vectors.name: depth64-number-then-forbidden-array
vectors.derivation: At byte 65 a bracket cannot follow the number in an array without a comma; it does not open container 65.
vectors.status: normative expected facts; hand-derived, not executed by this proposal

vectors.name: depth64-object-forbidden-array-name
vectors.derivation: The object at byte 63 is container 64. At byte 64 only a member name or object end is legal, so [ is lexical and opens nothing.
vectors.status: normative expected facts; hand-derived, not executed by this proposal

vectors.name: depth64-value-position-array65
vectors.derivation: The bracket at byte 64 is in a permitted value position and would open container 65.
vectors.status: normative expected facts; hand-derived, not executed by this proposal

vectors.name: candidate-with-unpaired-pack-value
vectors.derivation: The completed schema marker is remembered. The pack escape follows the code-unit lexical grammar. A protective eager getter must yield no usable folder, then full-byte admission rejects the unregistered candidate.
vectors.status: normative expected facts; hand-derived, not executed by this proposal

vectors.name: marker-before-depth64-forbidden-array
vectors.derivation: Root object plus 63 arrays reaches depth 64. A bracket after 1 is grammatically forbidden, so the earlier marker survives a lexical stop, not a depth stop.
vectors.status: normative expected facts; hand-derived, not executed by this proposal
